purpose: Adopt the FGTurbine zero-time trim fuel-flow fix into the app runtime. fork.5 shipped the defect: Trim() computed steady thrust and spool speeds but never assigned FuelFlow_pph, so every zero-time evaluation reported the previous operating point's fuel flow.

source.note: The companion spool fix (07eba55f, PR #1505) was already present in this branch's FGTurbine::Trim from the earlier consolidation, so only the fuel-flow half was outstanding.

runtimeEvidence.method: F16 fixture at 5000 ft / 300 KCAS. propulsion/set-running forces throttle to 1, so each setting is applied after it and trimmed by a further zero-time run_ic. Each setting is trimmed both in its own freshly booted executive and in one shared executive out of order.

fork5.observed: Every throttle setting reported 1548.9166 gph, the value left by set-running's forced full throttle, including at idle.

fork6.observed: Dry sweep 114.80, 284.34, 807.49, 1485.99 gph across commands 0.00, 0.20, 0.35, 0.49; augmented 7823.98 gph at 1.00. Order-dependence exactly zero.

runtimeEvidence.significance: This is the negative control for the adoption: the identical script fails on the retained fork.5 artifact and passes on fork.6, so the behaviour change is attributable to this package and not to the harness.

nativeRegressions.note: TestInputSocket fails on this machine with ModuleNotFoundError: telnetlib3, a test-only dependency absent from the venv since Python 3.14 removed stdlib telnetlib. Unrelated to this change.

fullAppSuite.note: The 16 failures recorded against fork.5 are resolved: the 10 phone-integration failures by dropping the stale aircraftCatalog mock, the 6 foss-earth recovery copies by scoping vitest away from gitignored build/.

nativeWasmParity.note: Native and WASM built from the same clean revision 0efc3e7a agree. The error is in line with the 1.4851e-4 recorded for fork.5.

sf50ValidationSuite.note: All metrics and initialization checks pass. The blocked status is SF50's standing calibration state (CG datum, brake control law, 50-foot datum, runway friction) and is unrelated to fuel flow. Static thrust remains 1772.01 lb against the 1846 lb EASA reference, diagnostic-only.

gateChanges: jsbsimBuildIdentity.ts accepts 1.2.4-fork.6 under @felipegalind0/jsbsim and retains fork.5 under the same name; fork.1-fork.4 keep the pre-rename name.
The identity test now pairs each accepted version with the name it was published under as explicit data rather than deriving it by string comparison, which would have misordered a future fork.10.
The next unissued version guarded by the rejection case advances from 1.2.4-fork.6 to 1.2.4-fork.7.

rollback.note: Rolling back to fork.5 restores the trim defect recorded under runtimeEvidence.

notDone: The SF50 idle fuel-flow decision is still open. This package corrects which operating point trim reports; it does not choose engine/fj33_5a.xml's idle flow, and the two lowest AFM cruise rows remain clamped at the estimated idle floor.
No re-run of the SF50 cruise fuel-flow diagnostic against this package is claimed; the recorded diagnostic ran natively, where the fix was already present.
No hosted CI run is claimed for this revision.
The build remains non-reproducible as recorded for fork.5; the tarball is the authority, not the commit.
